key.name: nyx-toggle-full
key.summary: Shortcut that switches between idle and full colour

key.name: character
key.summary: Which character shows: a key of extension/characters.json (nyx, okane); an unknown one shows Nyx

key.name: variant
key.summary: The look of the current character (Nyx: hips, hips-eve, hips-2b, hips-zelda, full-chibi, full-eve, full-2b, full-zelda, lying-chibi; Okane: hips, full); a look she does not have shows her default one

key.name: idle-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of Nyx in idle mode, in percent

key.name: animation-minutes
key.summary: Minutes between Nyx's moments (0 turns them off)

key.name: phrases
key.summary: Show Nyx's phrases in a speech bubble

key.name: sleep-minutes
key.summary: Minutes without keyboard or mouse before Nyx falls asleep (0 keeps her awake)

key.name: rotate-minutes
key.summary: Minutes between changes of form of her look: from the hips up, full body, lying (0 turns it off). Ignored while the schedule has entries

key.name: schedule
key.summary: Her look by time of day: entries 'H=look', each from hour H until the next entry, the last one past midnight. Choosing a variant by hand holds it until the next slot. An empty list turns it off

key.name: rest-minutes
key.summary: Minutes each pose lasts within her slot of the day: the slot opens with her usual look, then her resting poses take turns, carrying on the next day where they stopped (0 keeps her usual look)

key.name: pose-auto
key.summary: Automatic: her look follows the schedule or the change of form, and her resting poses take turns by the clock (rest-minutes). Off: the chosen look (variant) and the pose in the pose key stay

key.name: pose
key.summary: The resting pose that stays while pose-auto is off (a rest key of the shown look, such as rest-sit); empty, or a pose the look has not drawn, keeps her usual look. Meetings, heat, moments and naps still take over and come back to it

key.name: figure-offset
key.summary: Pixels (at 100 % size) her standing looks stand further right of the card's edge; 0 is where she stood before 2026-11-24, over the card's right edge

key.name: pc-name
key.summary: The PC's name on the card, after hers (NYX · SUPER PC); at most 20 characters show; empty, her name alone

key.name: stats-style
key.summary: How the card shows CPU, RAM and GPU: bars, blocks (segments), rings (gauges) or numbers (large values)

key.name: stats-colors
key.summary: The colours of CPU, RAM and GPU on the card (extension/skins.js); lavender is the card's colours before the palettes

key.name: meeting-ignore-apps
key.summary: Apps (application id or name, any case) whose use of the microphone is not a meeting. The first two are the volume controls GNOME's own mic indicator skips; the others are OBS

key.name: beach
key.summary: Beach mode: Nyx in her swimsuits, walking a series of resting poses (two of them lying on the wide card). The parasol beside the pin turns it on and off in full colour; it lasts until turned off

key.name: beach-minutes
key.summary: Minutes each pose of the beach mode lasts before the next one fades in

key.name: ups-name
key.summary: NUT name of the UPS on localhost:3493 she watches for power cuts (empty turns it off)

key.name: demo
key.summary: Plays a tour of every look and every animation, one step every 10 s, in full colour, then turns itself off

key.name: size
key.summary: Size of Nyx, in percent of the drawn image
